Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory with detailed room-by-room assessments, building ages, sizes, and conditions; includes multiple engineering assessments and community input; connects condition data to long-term capital planning (Component 1, pages 9-180).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections with methodology, site-specific capacity data, and connections to facility actions including new construction and repurposing; addresses declining enrollment and programmatic shifts (Component 1, Executive Summary and enrollment sections).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications, including flex rooms, specialist rooms, nursing rooms, and connections between facilities and district educational goals; projects respond directly to educational needs (Component 2, Logical Project Outline, pages 185-187).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: District-wide data on outdoor spaces including square footage, surface types, shade coverage, and stormwater management; detailed strategies for campus greening, shade structures, outdoor classrooms, rain gardens, and climate resilience framing (Component 1 Landscape Reports and Component 2 Project Outlines).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan addresses multiple climate impacts such as drainage and flooding with detailed site-level assessments; includes resilience strategies like shade structures, synthetic turf, and stormwater improvements; climate readiness is a theme in planning and projects (Component 1 Civil and Landscape Assessments, Component 2 Project Outlines).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Comprehensive energy strategies including electrification of HVAC, replacement of gas systems with heat pumps, photovoltaic installations, battery storage, and microgrids; references state requirements (Title 24, ZNE goals); detailed energy data and resilience planning (Component 1 Mechanical Reports, Component 2 Project Outlines, Component 3 Budgets).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a detailed capital strategy with itemized cost estimates, prioritization framework, multiple funding sources including bonds and state grants, and long-term financial sustainability considerations; includes escalation and contingency assumptions (Component 3 Preliminary Budget and Schedule).
